facts.fact: The StackAdapt case study with Tuff Growth was published on 2023-06-29.
Per Tuff Growth, display testing for a client offering online certificate programs drove over 1 million impressions and 1,500 clicks on StackAdapt.
facts.quote: During our testing with display, we’ve driven over 1 million impressions and 1,500 clicks–all while achieving a higher time on site than social channels have delivered.

facts.fact: Per Tuff Growth, a mental health awareness audio ad campaign on StackAdapt produced 200,000 impressions, an audio completion rate over 90%, and 200 leads.
facts.quote: We’ve seen 200,000 impressions, over 90% audio completion rate, and 200 leads.

facts.fact: Per Tuff Growth, for many of its clients StackAdapt drove CPC and CPM 20% to 30% lower than other platforms.
facts.quote: For countless others, we have been able to drive CPC and CPM 20% to 30% lower than what we have seen on other platforms.

facts.fact: Per Tuff Growth, one client's StackAdapt campaign running about 3 months reached over 1 million impressions and was associated with a 2% increase in branded traffic.
facts.quote: Over this time, we have reached over 1 million impressions, resulting in a 2% increase in branded traffic.

facts.fact: Over the same roughly 3-month period, that client's CTR rose by 5% and impressions rose by 1%, per Tuff Growth.
facts.quote: CTR has increased by 5%, and impressions have increased by 1% over this same period.

facts.fact: Tuff Growth describes itself as a plug-in growth marketing team that partners with startups and established players.
facts.quote: Tuff is a plug-in growth marketing team. They team up with startups and established players alike
